datasets.name: MILUV: Multi-UAV Indoor Localization dataset with UWB and Vision
datasets.notes: Paper describes 217 minutes, 36 experiments, three UAVs, UWB raw timestamps/CIR, stereo and monocular cameras, IMU, laser height, magnetometer and motion-capture ground truth. Exact downloaded file set and hashes, per-sensor time alignment, frame transforms, calibration artifacts and held-out experiment split still need review.

datasets.name: UrbanNav Hong Kong urban-canyon multisensor dataset
datasets.notes: Official repository states MIT terms include dataset files. Candidate tracks include medium/deep/harsh urban and tunnel. Some pilot data lacks hardware synchronization; some sequences have ground-truth gaps or calibration omissions. Select an exact sequence and verify that sequence-specific limitations are acceptable.

datasets.name: Tank underwater multisensor SLAM evaluation dataset
datasets.notes: Eight controlled tank sequences with stereo, IMU, DVL, depth pressure and fiducial-marker-based 6-DoF ground truth. Official page limits use to non-commercial academic research under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Excluded from commercial benchmark or commercial product paths unless separately licensed.

datasets.name: SubT-MRS multi-robot subterranean SLAM dataset
datasets.notes: Candidate real-world multi-platform RGB/LiDAR/thermal/IMU dataset with cave, tunnel and adverse-visibility conditions. No dataset payload rights are asserted here; obtain exact license and sequence-specific ground-truth/calibration details before admission.

datasets.name: HK-UrbanSpoof: urban GPS L1 synchronous spoofing and GNSS/INS reference dataset
datasets.notes: Candidate only. GitHub repo main commit 95def2b6a42eee6299bbc1a5b880a9f3bfc070d6; README blob feda2d04eb801862539164561a1315ca450eee02. Repository has no LICENSE file and GitHub API license=null. Raw IF files are external Google Drive objects, not pinned in the Git repository; no SHA-256 file inventory is recorded. S2_GT.txt and S3_GT.txt are present in the repository; README describes them as time-tagged post-processed GNSS/INS position, velocity and attitude, but timestamp/clock and oracle independence require review. README still says ray-tracing labels are coming soon and retains an older ground-truth-release sentence despite the present S2/S3 files. S1/S2/S3 are real-source scenarios; S4 is simulated and uses a different IF configuration and must be evaluated separately. Public download availability is not a data licence; obtain author confirmation for research, commercial use and redistribution before admission.
